title: Concept: Gradle dependency declared with a latest-version selector
description: build.gradle declares a `latest.release` or `latest.integration` selector, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Every build takes whatever the repository marks as latest, including integration builds, so the compiled code changes with no commit.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through build.gradle (gradle).
risk: Every build takes whatever the repository marks as latest, including integration builds, so the compiled code changes with no commit.
